title: Mixture of Uniform has a different behavior
author: hsimonfroy

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body:
I think this is a bug in MixtureSameFamily https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/master/numpyro/distributions/mixtures.py#L246. The event shape should be:

```
(mixture_size,) + component_distribution.event_shape
```

comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body: Based on my review, the implementations of all distributions are functioning as expected. I have concluded that the issue originates within `numpyro.sample`, specifically in the `numpyro.primitive.apply_stack` function.

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body: My bad. I interpreted the mixture logic incorrectly. Let me look closer - it seems to only happen in `render_model`

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body:
I guess the support of MixtureSameFamily is wrong @Qazalbash?

https://github.com/pyro-ppl/numpyro/blob/c38f0f4da174d0e0328aecddf36c645bb81f868b/numpyro/distributions/mixtures.py#L262

comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body: Yes, the problem is in the constraint. I changed the `numpyro.distribution.continuous.Uniform` constraint to `numpyro.distribution.constraints.real` to test and found no bug.

comments.author: fehiepsi
comments.body: Yeah, I think we should raise an error in mixturedsamefamily if the component support is not parameter free. With parameter constraints, they are likely not belonging to the same family with the same support.

comments.author: Qazalbash
comments.body:
Sure, sure, I will open a PR for this change.
